The main takeaway from our work is that
the most sensitive algorithm is the one that targets the parameter space of a specific source population.

a search strategy should be selected to cover the parameter space of interest, with a focus on the region of highest astrophysical interest, and that a single search is unlikely to be sensitive over the entire parameter space.
